verdict.language_detail: MUMPS/M (VistA RPMS routine, ECME Claims Management Engine)
verdict.provenance_detail: VistA BPS (E Claims Management Engine) package routine BPSSCRCV, patch BPS*1.0*7, part of wvehr2-dewdrop VistA fork
verdict.purpose: Implements the ECME (Electronic Claims Management Engine) user screen 'Change View' functionality in VistA, allowing users to edit and save their profile settings (filters for claims display such as user, patient, Rx, timeframe, eligibility type, open/closed claims, submission type, etc.) using PARAMETER TOOLS and FileMan APIs.
